crossRefs.note: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,
blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and…

translations.web: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
translations.bsb: They shall use gold, along with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.
translations.kjv: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
translations.asv: And they shall take the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
